masterV2.prompt: Edit this exact character into a game sprite master: keep the SAME character identity, face, long black beard, green headcloth, green robe with gold dragon embroidery, ornate gold dragon scale armor, and the same ornate guandao polearm with curved blade and gold dragon detail. Change ONLY the pose and framing: strict side view facing right, relaxed ready combat stance, feet slightly apart planted on the ground, both hands holding the guandao diagonally across the body with the blade raised up and forward to the right, shaft angled down-back to the left. The whole character including the full weapon occupies only about 65% of the frame height, centered, with GENEROUS empty margin on ALL sides, especially in front (right) and top for weapon swings — nothing touches or is cropped by any edge. Flat pure solid magenta #ff00ff background, no shadow, no ground, no text, no scenery. Detailed painted illustration style, not pixel art, clean edges.
masterV2.assessment: Identity, face, costume and weapon preserved very well on attempt 1; diagonal ready stance with generous margins as requested.

commandsPerAction: asset-pipeline.py extract '<video>.mp4' 'frames-<action>-a<N>-raw' --fps 12   (fresh dir each time; 544x544 PNGs)

frameSelection.note: 1-based source frame numbers (frame-XXXX.png) from the keyed dirs. All three videos share an identical first frame / coordinate system.

idle.rationale: Source sway is a one-way drift (alpha IoU vs frame 3 declines monotonically 1.0->0.84, no return), so the loop is built ping-pong for a seamless breathing cycle.

walk.rationale: Alpha-IoU periodicity shows a ~12-frame gait cycle; frames 6..17 sampled evenly to 8.

attack.rationale: ready, wind-up, wind-up peak, chop start, chop lands, full extension, recovery x2, back to ready. The long low-pose hold (source frames 15-31) is compressed out.

normalization.scaleRationale: Idle head-to-feet measures ~310px in source; 380px on canvas would need s=1.23, but the extended attack pose spans 482px wide in source (would become 591px > 512 canvas) and the wind-up reaches 442px above the feet (would become 542 > 472 available above ground). Scale was therefore capped at s=1.02 by the nothing-cropped constraint: character ~316px tall on canvas, widest frame ~492px (~10px side margins), ~21px top margin at wind-up peak. This deviates from the ~380px guideline; the game can display-scale the sprite as needed since groundY is exact.
normalization.translation: Single global dx centering the union of all selected frames (source x 22..504) on canvas x=256; dy maps source ground 472 -> canvas 472. No per-frame cropping or recentering.
normalization.perActionOffsetRationale: Measured after first pass: idle soles sat 2px below the ground line; walk torso centroid sat ~6px right of idle (walk clip drifts right after its identical first frame). After correction, planted-foot bottom = y 472/473 in all actions.
normalization.despill: Strongly magenta-dominant pixels (min(R,B)-G > 40) within 2px of the silhouette edge are dropped; all remaining pixels have magenta dominance neutralized (R and B reduced by min(R,B)-G where positive). Residual magenta-dominant visible pixels in final frames: 1-3 per frame.
normalization.outputs: public/assets/frames/guanyu/{idle,walk,attack}_<i>.png (512x512 RGBA) + manifest.json; combined verification sheet at assets-source/guanyu/contact-sheet.png (rows per action over dark background, red ground line at y=472).

knownDefects: Scale compromise: character is ~316px tall on the 512 canvas instead of ~380px (see scaleRationale) — required so the fully extended guandao fits uncropped at one shared scale.

Attack blade tint shifts greenish-gold and the blade reads flatter/more elongated in the strike-end frames (attack_4, attack_5) compared with the silver blade in idle/walk — a video-generation artifact; blade never disappears or crops.

Attack is a diagonal down-chop ending low (blade at knee height), not a horizontal slash, and the strike itself is fast (2 source frames). Body turns slightly 3/4 toward camera in the follow-through frames (attack_5..7) but head stays in profile.

Walk: robe hem covers the legs heavily, so the gait reads mostly through hem sway and the visible swinging boot. Walk passing poses (walk_0..2) sit ~5px above the ground line (both feet mid-step in the source video) — natural bob, preserved.
Idle loop is ping-pong (frames repeat in reverse) because the source clip's sway never returns to its start pose; motion is subtle breathing only.
Minor cross-action horizontal wobble remains (torso centroid within ~+/-6px) inherent to the generated videos.
Source resolution is 480p (544x544 frames), so final sprites are slightly soft when displayed larger than ~350px.
